text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn)— The grandstands 
were packed to the brim with racing fans.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back! Briiiaaan!! Show us that 
incredible running that blows past 
everyone here too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
An injury isn't a wall you can't climb! 
The next chapter of your legend begins 
right here!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Show them that strongest run once more—!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
My, such ragged breathing... Your fighting 
instincts are truly blazing, aren't 
they...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
This is the "Monster"..., our 
strongest...! Today, once again, she 
captivates us with her race...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...It is quite like a festival, isn't it? 
Everyone seems swept up in the excitement.
choice_data_list: Because it's Narita Brian's comeback race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's Brian-chan's first race since 
recovering from her injury.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
choice_data_list: It's okay, you can do it.
It's okay, you can do it

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While the crowd was enraptured by the 
hero's return, Sakura Laurel made up her 
mind. And so, they saw her off to the 
paddock—
